description: This file defines the Route class within the Slim Framework, handling routing logic such as route pattern matching, middleware management, and request handling.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a route in the Slim Framework, managing HTTP methods, pattern, callables, middleware, and request handling.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the callable resolver used by this route.

methods.name: getInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the invocation strategy for this route.

methods.name: setInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets the invocation strategy for this route.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Returns the HTTP methods supported by this route.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets the route pattern.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable associated with this route.

methods.name: setCallable
methods.description: Sets the callable for this route.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the route.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the route.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for this route.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument by name, with an optional default.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments for the route.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Sets multiple arguments for the route, optionally including them in saved arguments.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware instance to the route.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the route with given arguments, merging with saved arguments.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets a single argument, optionally including it in saved arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the route, handling middleware and returning a response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Resolves the route's callable and invokes it with the request.
